newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint ends up vs dlr, lower vs NBH basket.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint ends up vs dlr, lower vs NBH basket.

text.p: BUDAPEST, April 28 (REUTER) - Hungary's forint closed firmer against the dollar tracking the dollar/mark cross, but drifted slightly lower within the National Bank of Hungary's floating resistance level (NBH bid), dealers said on Monday.
The forint closed at 182.15/19 to the dollar, compared with 182.20/25 at midday and 182.00 at the opening.
Dealers said the forint followed the movements of the dollar/mark rate in a narrow range, while the gap from the NBH bid opened to about 13 pips on foreign currency buyings from below 10 at midday.
"The main cause was ...that there were position closings on the (foreign currency) futures market," said Inter-Europa Bank's Ervin Csengeri.
He added that investors took profits on Swiss franc, yen and mark futures short positions, opened earlier, increasing demand for foreign currencies on the spot market.

However, the forint was unlikely to keep the current distance from the NBH bid long, and in the near future it is likely to move in a maximum 10 pip range below the NBH resistance level, dealers said.
The forint floats within the NBH's 4.5 percent wide intervention band, against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and seventy percent of the dollar.
